facts.summary: Phase 3 missed primary PFS endpoint vs trabectedin; development stopped · Phase 3 · milademetan in dedifferentiated liposarcoma · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The Phase 3 MANTRA trial did not meet the primary endpoint of progression free survival vs. standard of care
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: did not meet its primary endpoint of progression free survival (PFS) by blinded independent central review compared to the standard of care, trabectedin.
evidence.safety: The most common Grade 3/4 TEAEs were thrombocytopenia (39.5%), neutropenia (25.5%) and anemia (18.6%).
evidence.program_discontinued: Based upon these topline data, Rain does not expect to pursue further development of milademetan in DD LPS.
